desc: Analyze problem and propose algorithm (ideation complete).
Compute `dp_pre[i]`: min cost to cover `[1, i]` using only Op 1.
Compute `dp_suf[i]`: min cost to cover `[i, N]` using only Op 1.
Implement efficient computation of `Cost(L, R)` for all Op 2s using a segment tree with offline processing or a specialized DP structure.
Iterate through all Op 2 operations `(L, R)`. For each, calculate `cost = 1 + Cost(L, R)`. Update `min_cost` if smaller.
Determine if the optimal solution uses an Op 2 or only Op 1s.
If using Op 2 at index `k` with range `[L, R]`, select Op 2 for `k`. Then solve for covering `[L, R]` using Op 1s.
